entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I'm pulling up the right order, can I get your full name?
Thank you, Maria. I see your order here, delivered 18 days ago. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just not what I wanted. It's really confusing.
I'm sorry to hear that. Could you tell me a little more about what's causing trouble?
The whole interface is just hard to use. I read the user manual, but it didn't help. Honestly, I expected more from it.
I understand completely. One moment while I review the return eligibility for you.

Okay, thanks for your patience. I see the delivery was 18 days ago, and our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You're well within the window, so I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Oh. Fine. Just send me the label then.

Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 5 minutes. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method. Does that sound good?
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.
You certainly will. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
